description: This file defines constants, structures, and class declarations related to NGAP (Next Generation Application Protocol) common message handling in 3GPP ASN.1 specifications, including identifiers, private information element structures, and related methods.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Represents a private Information Element ID with options for local or global scope, including methods for setting, getting, packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template struct representing a private IE field with an ID, criticality, and value, including methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template struct for items in a private IE container, with methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private_ie_id_c to a specified option (local, global, nulltype).

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the current type of private_ie_id_c.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into a bit_ref buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a cbit_ref buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the object into JSON format.
